Title: Source 3: Washington Crossing the Delaware
Author: by Emanuel Leutze
Content: This picture shows General George Washington leading the Continental Army across the Delaware River during the American Revolution. Washington led a surprise attack against German soldiers fighting for the British in Trenton, New Jersey. The Continental Army attacked early in the morning on `text(December 26, 1776)`. The battle was the `text(first)` major success or the Continental Army. The painting shown in the picture was created in `text(1851)`, almost `75` `text(years)` later.
